notes: Static fallback catalog updated from CREATE TABLE definitions in the supplied s_demo.sql. No row data imported. Runtime introspection determines which tables and columns actually exist.

excluded_tables.conversations: Conversation/message history - explicitly excluded by project requirement.
excluded_tables.threads: Conversation thread metadata - explicitly excluded by project requirement.
excluded_tables.auth_sessions: Authentication infrastructure containing session/token material; intentionally excluded from natural-language querying.
excluded_tables.client_ai_conversations: Stored user questions and AI conversation history; excluded consistently with other chat tables.
excluded_tables.finance_integrations: Integration configuration can contain credentials or tokens; excluded from natural-language queries.
excluded_tables.roles: Authorization definitions, permission JSON and super-admin configuration; excluded from natural-language queries.

guard_availabilities.description: Dated guard availability windows using start_at and end_at DATETIME values, not recurring time-only schedules. The live unique key allows one row per guard_id and day_of_week.

columns.guard_id: Business-confirmed reference to guards.id. Relationship: many_to_one; not a database-enforced foreign key.
columns.day_of_week: Recorded weekday enum: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Use the full start_at/end_at timestamps for date-specific queries; weekday alone is insufficient.
columns.status: Recorded status; use documented enum literals. Do not infer numeric status meanings. Allowed values: available, preferred, unavailable.
columns.start_at: Nullable DATETIME marking the full calendar date and start of the recorded availability window. NULL does not establish a start.
columns.end_at: Nullable DATETIME marking the full calendar date and end of the recorded availability window, possibly on a later date. NULL does not establish an end.
